situation: My team won big and played selfish, ugly ball the entire game.

dims.SPEAKABILITY: Card 1's "I can coach a team that plays that way... I cannot do both" is a sharp, sayable ultimatum, while Card 2's "make the people around them dangerous" and the round-robin "name one moment" ask are slightly more mechanical to deliver live.
dims.SPECIFICITY: Card 1's diagnosis nails the exact trap of this situation — that winning validates the selfishness and threatens to swallow a team win in personal glory — whereas Card 2's status read is solid but could apply to most any ugly-win scenario.
dims.TIGHTNESS: Card 1's script is more compressed and each beat lands a distinct blow, while Card 2 pads slightly with the extra "not to beat yourself up" hedging and a longer commitment section.
dims.HONESTY: Card 1 refuses to let the win buy a pass and forces the players to answer the harder identity question themselves, holding the standard more uncompromisingly than Card 2's gentler "we were not there" framing.
